findings.issue: Only formal RUN verifies FREEZE code pins; counterfactual runners skip FREEZE entirely and counterfactual seal has no formal freeze reference.
findings.repair: Verify frozen science and source pins at CF START, bind formal freeze and selection in CF seal, and verify these before reference reads.

findings.repair: Either compare committed_edges() normalized write records or document counter as changed source/target commit-pair lists only; report phase/reference separately.

findings.issue: D1 reason=None admits cost>=1 edges although dummy will usually beat them. First legal deletion need not prevent an original selected commit.
findings.repair: Keep matrix deletion and actual selection/commit/publication changes distinct; zero-effect ALLOW/VETO remains valid.

findings.issue: Full lossless sample state is serialized several times per frame; no scope change proposed from static concern alone.
findings.estimate: ~43 min for 20,098 frames at this Feeding density with two workers; longer 12-second window may differ, FishSA fewer masks may reduce cost.
